_about: Garment shapes made on every friend's own body by tools/meshy/make_clothes.py (owner 9 Nov 2026: dozens of outfits to come; a new shape is a row here, a new outfit is a set of shapes and colours in js/friend-model.ts GARMENTS). Numbers in strings are measured on each body: NECK, WAIST, HIP, KNEE, ANKLE, TOP_HEM (HIP - .03), KIT_LEG_T (the swim shorts' reach along the thigh, 0..2), BIB_TOP, BIB_X. faces: the body triangles copied (top: lowest point of the trunk part; sleeve and leg: how far along the arm or leg, 0 shoulder or hip, 1 elbow or knee, 2 hand or ankle; under_waist: all of the trunk below the waist). cuts: straight hems (neck, hem:<z>, arm:<t>, leg:<t>, up:<z>, side:<x>). layer: 0 under (trousers), 1 tops, 2 over (skirts, panels, bib), 3 shoes. Each shape of layers 0-2 has its own cover bit (body: 8, garments: 8): at most 8 of each in one model.
